answer: Most convincing defense: on-ledger slashing of verifiers. Each verifier stakes native tokens; countersigning an invalid transaction burns that stake automatically, with the burn exceeding any epoch reward. Detection ripples out like a fraud proof that every node echoes, slashing all cosigners at once. An attacker's fleet of fake identities is a jetty of stakes: each sybil costs real locked collateral plus expected loss, far above any reward it could vote itself. Attack becomes a guaranteed net loss.
